title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional MONTH-end capping check effective at the open of 2027-04-30 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-04-27 close), the check that decides how far the May and June tests drift
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, read direct by this proposer and DISPUTED BETWEEN TWO OWNER DOCUMENTS. FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-09): every Russell US Style row in section 4.8.6 reads frequency "Monthly", price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". AGAINST THAT, FTSE Russell's "Frequently Asked Questions -- Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams, re-fetched the same session) still says verbatim "The review is conducted quarterly (March, June, September, and December)". If the FAQ governs, this event does not exist. THE 2027 DATES ARE RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: the last business day of April 2027 is Friday 2027-04-30 (no NYSE closure falls in April 2027 -- src/domain/market-calendar.ts, whose 2027 closure set this session reproduced independently), and walking T-3 back in business days gives the price date Tuesday 2027-04-27. The id follows the family convention of naming the EFFECTIVE date, as russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2026-10-30 and -2026-11-30 both do. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract, because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and because the owner's own two documents disagree about whether the check happens at all. Discovered during the russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2027-05-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 TO REVERSE A SPECIFIC, MEASURED DECLINE rather than to add calendar filler, and the reversal is the whole reason this file exists. russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 explicitly declined this date: "the 2027-04-27 month-end check (real under the guide's reading, but it changes no number here -- the 05-25 check resets after it either way)". That rationale is the RESET FALLACY this family already refuted one instance earlier: russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2026-11-30's headline 1 quotes guide section 4.8.4 verbatim -- "If none of the applicable trigger thresholds are breached, no change is implemented as a result of the additional capping check" -- so a conditional check cannot be assumed to reset. The 2027-05-25 check is measured at a 20.28% firing probability, so it supersedes the April check in about one path in five, not "either way". MEASURED CONSEQUENCE, on 1,281 daily bars (2021-08-02 to 2026-09-08), IWY cohort held at a 45% post-review reset and needing +6.67% against its own fund to breach 48%: modelling the April check removes 16.45pp from the 2027-05-25 test's own breach probability (36.73% -> 20.28%) and 11.93pp from the 2027-06-25 June quarter-end test (44.24% -> 32.31%). A calendar carrying the May and June tests but not this one mis-states both by double digits. ONE PATH-DEPENDENCE STATED UP FRONT, because it is counter-intuitive and a later lane would otherwise read it as an arithmetic error: adding the April check RAISES the June test's breach probability from 15.74% to 17.32% once the May check is also modelled, because an April firing re-anchors the cohort at 45% and thereby stops the May check firing, leaving the June test measured from the earlier anchor over a longer window. The effect of a conditional reset on a downstream test is not monotone in the number of resets. HOW IT WOULD BE CONFIRMED OR KILLED, so the next lane need not re-derive it: an FTSE Russell index notice recording a Russell US Style recap effective on any month-end that is not also a quarter-end (2026-10-30 and 2026-11-30 are the nearest, both already tracked and both scored by their own lanes) confirms the monthly cadence from the tape rather than from a table; a guide version past v5.4, or an FAQ revision restoring quarterly wording for the section 4.8.6 Russell US Style rows, kills this entry and it should be withdrawn rather than researched. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on the family's measured grounds: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (0 hits in trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md, re-grepped 2026-09-09), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. Proposed as an estimate on a disputed rule with a conditional trigger; nothing here licenses an entry.
